description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldDateTimecombo, which extends SugarWidgetFieldDateTime. It provides specialized methods for handling datetime fields in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework, including a method for generating a SQL filter for datetime ranges in reports.

classes.description: A class for handling datetime combo widget fields, extending the basic DateTime widget class with additional filtering capabilities for reporting range queries.
